changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'RedGate') BEGIN EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA RedGate') END

changeSet.author: redgate
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'RedGate.FeedbackAudit') AND type in (N'U')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE RedGate.FeedbackAudit ( AuditID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, CustomerID INTEGER, Note VARCHAR(200), CreatedAt DATETIMEOFFSET NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() ); END
